payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_task.py::test_claude_md_command_table_names_the_cells_raise_not_just_its_green_review stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to CLAUDE.md. The claim was 'CLAUDE.md:65\'s command-table comment for `saffron package` says "...whose own PACKAGE raised, or whose cell went green," naming the second, `SA-0380`-added case only by its green cell, with no raise in sight. Read alone, "whose cell went green" is equally true of an ordinary `READY_FOR_REVIEW` task, since reaching REVIEW is itself a green cell with no raise. CLAUDE.md\'s own `saffron/task.py` layout bullet already names that same second case precisely: the bullet starts at line 159 with "- `saffron/task.py` — `run_task` drives one task end to end...", and its clause "a task whose PACKAGE raised, or whose cell raised but rebuilds green" wraps onto line 161, two physical lines below the bullet\'s own leading text. The command-table line instead carries that exact qualifier, "whose cell raised but rebuilds green," word for word, so an operator skimming either line reads the same gate.', and the whole `tests` gate stayed green under the edit too.
